summary: Payette NF lookout: L-4 cab on a 10-foot pole, built 1934. Sources give destruction in 1959 or removal. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 10-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Two sources say it was destroyed in 1959; a third lists it only as removed. No source describes what remains.

events.note: L-4 cab on a 10-foot pole tower; firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Weebly page all give 1934
Archive photo dated 1952 shows ranger Val Simpson on the steps
Photo caption calls it now abandoned, says the structure beneath it is badly deteriorated, and says it is to be destroyed
firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date destruction to 1959; the Weebly page says removed, with no date

notes_for_editor: Name spelled Roots Knob in the record and on two lookout sites; the UI archive calls it Root Knob. Record height_m 3.0 not written as a fact: sources give only a 10-foot pole (about 3.05 m), not a cab-floor height. The UI photo (archivalidaho193) is In Copyright, Educational Use Permitted, so it is not listed under photos. The Living New Deal page returned HTTP 403 and was not read. Nothing says what remains at the site today; access left unset.
